profile: An old sailor by the fire, slow and weathered, proud at the end
persona: An old sailor by the fire, slow and weathered, proud at the end

lines.text: On the edge of the world stood one light.
And one night, it went out.
One old man cannot be a lighthouse.
A lighthouse was never one flame. It was everyone who kept it.

omni.design: male, elderly, low pitch, british accent
omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
